adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path now does `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists `key` to Prisma. But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file) returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error? }`), not the parsed credential payload (`.data`). Therefore the DB will store the wrapper object instead of the credential shape that `googleCredentialSchema.parse(...)` previously enforced, likely breaking subsequent loads/parses of `credential.key` for Google Calendar after the first refresh.
